scientific_target.question: At observed Set, do strictly pre-Set DMFC counts improve prediction of released behavioral tp relative to the same competent procedure using known cues and elapsed session clock?
scientific_target.known_answer: Released behavioral tp in milliseconds for every original258 validation/query trial. Do not replace it with Go-minus-Set or a neural-speed correlation.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Pinned original NWB intervals/trials/tp field; source converter preserves all original train/val rows and verifies positive finite selected targets without filtering.
scientific_target.case_unit: One trial at observed Set, with four50ms pre-Set bins from40 held-in units.
scientific_target.independent_unit: One exposed animal/session: Haydn20161211. Trials and40 conditions are repeated observations, not independent animals.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Offline prediction at Set from processed spikes on the historical within-session development panel. This is not a200ms advance forecast, online sorting qualification or independent session/animal replication.
exclusions: NLB response-aligned neural-speed correlation as prospective tp prediction
Mode labels as evidence of native understanding or interactive reasoning advantage

primary.name: mean absolute error of released tp in milliseconds
primary.aggregation: Mean over all258 required query trials per arm; report paired cue-minus-neural per-trial errors within each mode.
primary.rationale: Measures the behavioral quantity directly and retains absolute competency alongside neural increments; a weak cue procedure cannot by itself establish useful neural understanding.

secondary: RMSE_ms and unweighted eight-context macro MAE.
All40 condition MAEs and all8 context MAEs, with complete support.
Paired cue-minus-neural MAE and equal-context macro increment, computed from per-trial errors; positive means lower neural error.
Signed candidate-minus-each-fixed-reference differences; negative means better candidate error.

evaluation.uncertainty: No population confidence interval, p-value or scientific pass floor is defined for one exposed session. Report finite-panel errors and all context/condition support; any within-session resampling is descriptive and must respect temporal dependence.
evaluation.failure_policy: All four exact complete-ID NPZ artifacts are captured and publicly validated before private decoding. Reject duplicate/missing/extra IDs, object dtypes, nonfinite/oversized submissions; valid finite negative predictions remain scored. Preserve finite poor errors and overflow as explicit failure, never clipping or dropping cases.
